ابتعدت (form VIII)
# اِبْتَعَدْتُ (ibtaʕadtu) /ib.ta.ʕad.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
# اِبْتَعَدْتَ (ibtaʕadta) /ib.ta.ʕad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
# اِبْتَعَدْتِ (ibtaʕadti) /ib.ta.ʕad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
# اِبْتَعَدَتْ (ibtaʕadat) /ib.ta.ʕa.dat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
